cedict.what: CC-CEDICT release 2026-05-18 (124,933 entries), parsed to JSON by the npm package @leonsilicon/cc-cedict 0.0.0 (header metadata kept). Licence CC BY-SA 4.0 (MDBG).

hsk2025.what: Official 2025 HSK exam syllabus PDF 《中文水平考试 HSK考试大纲》 (CLEC, 2025-11), mirrored in docrealm/docs-hsk.

hsk2021.what: GF 0025-2021 word list (11,092 terms) with pinyin and POS, cleaned by ivankra/hsk30 (MIT).

hsk20.what: HSK 2.0 (2012) word lists, levels 1-6 (5,000 words), clem109/hsk-vocabulary (MIT).

wordfreq.what: wordfreq 3.1.1 Chinese "large" frequency list (data CC BY-SA 4.0), from the PyPI wheel.

audio-cmn.what: Native-speaker Mandarin recordings (hugolpz/audio-cmn): 1,707 syllables (Chen Wang) and 8,596 HSK words (Yue Tan, Shtooka/SWAC). CC BY-SA.
